name: RBI IT Framework
description: Reserve Bank of India Information Technology Vision (2011) + Master Direction on Information Technology Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices (2016) — applicable to banks and NBFCs regulated by RBI.

controls.name: IT strategy aligned to business
controls.req: IT strategy committee / board-level IT governance with documented alignment to business strategy.

controls.name: IT steering committee
controls.req: Establish an IT Steering Committee chaired by senior management with periodic reviews and minutes.

controls.name: IT policies approved & communicated
controls.req: Board-approved IT, IS and BCM policies, reviewed at defined frequency.

controls.name: CISO role defined
controls.req: Define CISO/ISG head role with direct reporting to senior management and adequate independence.

controls.name: IT risk management framework
controls.req: Framework aligned to ISO 31000/Basel: risk appetite, identification, assessment, mitigation, monitoring.

controls.name: Risk register with owners
controls.req: Maintain an IT risk register with risk owners, ratings, treatment plans and review cycles.

controls.name: Third-party/vendor risk
controls.req: Vendor due-diligence, contracts with security clauses, ongoing monitoring, exit strategy (esp. cloud and outsourcing).

controls.name: Cyber risk indicators
controls.req: Define cyber KRIs (patch latency, incident counts, MTTD/MTTR) reported to board-level.

controls.name: IS audit function
controls.req: Independent IS audit function (CISA-qualified) with risk-based audit coverage.

controls.name: Audit frequency & coverage
controls.req: Audit critical systems at least annually; audit trail + exception reporting to Board/Audit Committee.

controls.name: VAPT by independent agency
controls.req: VAPT by empanelled agencies at defined frequency (annually and on major changes; also after security incidents).

controls.name: ISACA/CISA alignment
controls.req: Align assurance practices with ISACA/COBIT to satisfy regulator inspection expectations.

controls.name: BCP/DR plan
controls.req: Documented BCP & DR policy with RTO/RPO per business process criticality classification.

controls.name: DR site with tested recovery
controls.req: Off-site DR facility with periodic testing (minimum frequency per RBI guidance) and test reports.

controls.name: Backup integrity & retention
controls.req: Tape/cloud backups with verification of recovery, retention policy, and off-site storage.

controls.name: Business impact analysis refresh
controls.req: Re-run BIA on org changes; update recovery priorities and procedures.

controls.name: Information security framework
controls.req: Framework covering access control, data classification, encryption, network security, malware defence.

controls.name: SOC / 24x7 monitoring
controls.req: Establish SOC or 24x7 monitoring with defined playbooks for alerts and escalation.

controls.name: Incident response plan
controls.req: IR plan with roles, communication (incl. RBI reporting), containment/eradication/recovery, lessons learned.

controls.name: Reporting to RBI
controls.req: Report significant cyber incidents to RBI within the notified timeframe; comply with specific reporting formats.

controls.name: Patch & vulnerability management
controls.req: CVSS-based SLAs, patch testing, and vulnerability scanning of external and internal surfaces.

controls.name: Access control reviews
controls.req: Least privilege, quarterly access reviews, immediate revocation on exit, privileged access management.

controls.name: Cloud adoption framework
controls.req: Board-approved cloud strategy incl. risk assessment, regulatory (DPDP/PMLA) and data-localization checks.

controls.name: Cloud security responsibilities
controls.req: Explicit shared-responsibility mapping, encryption key management, and contractual controls for hyperscalers.

controls.name: Data residency & exit
controls.req: Define data residency requirements, egress/exit plan, and data deletion obligations on cloud exit.

controls.name: AI/ML governance
controls.req: For AI deployments: model risk management, bias/fairness checks, explainability, and audit trail (aligning with RBI's Responsible AI approach).

source: RBI IT Vision 2011 + Master Direction ITGRCA (2016) + 2024 cloud circular
